Security for Government Facilities

GSA-compliant blast mitigation and anti-intrusion films to protect our public servants and buildings.

Meeting the Highest Standards of Protection

Government buildings, from federal courthouses to local municipal offices, are often high-risk targets for terrorism, civil unrest, and other security threats. The General Services Administration (GSA) and the Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC) have established stringent standards for building security, with a major focus on the performance of windows during a blast event. Our security window films are tested to meet these exacting standards, providing a critical layer of protection for government personnel and property.

Blast Mitigation: The Primary Goal

In an explosion, flying glass is one of the greatest threats, causing the majority of injuries and deaths. Blast mitigation window film is designed to handle the extreme pressures of a bomb blast.

  • Holds Glass Together: When a blast wave hits a window, the film and a robust attachment system (like a structural silicone or mechanical frame) absorb the energy and hold the glass shards together, preventing them from becoming deadly projectiles.
  • Meets GSA and UFC Criteria: We offer films and attachment systems that have been independently tested and certified to meet specific government blast performance levels (e.g., GSA Level C, UFC Level 2).
  • Reduces Spall: The film contains not only the glass on the exterior but also prevents 'spall'—small particles of glass that can be ejected from the interior surface of the window at high velocity.

Comprehensive Government Security Solutions

Beyond blast mitigation, our films provide a full spectrum of protection for government facilities:

  • Forced Entry / Intrusion Detection: The same films protect against forced entry attempts, securing sensitive areas from unauthorized access.
  • RF Attenuation: We offer specialty films that can help to block RF/IR signals, preventing electronic eavesdropping in secure facilities (SCIFs).
  • UV and Solar Control: Combination films can add energy efficiency and comfort to government buildings, reducing operational costs while enhancing security.

We have the experience and product knowledge to work with government facility managers, security consultants, and contractors to specify and install security solutions that meet all required performance criteria. Protect your facility and personnel with proven, tested technology. Contact us for a confidential consultation.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is an attachment system and why is it required?

An attachment system is a method of anchoring the film to the window frame itself. This can be a 'wet glaze' system using structural silicone or a 'mechanical' system with a metal batten. It is required for all blast mitigation applications to ensure the entire window system (film, glass, and frame) acts as a single unit to resist the blast pressure.

Are your installers cleared for work in secure facilities?

Our lead installation technicians are highly professional, and we are experienced in working within the specific security protocols and access requirements of government and military facilities. We can provide all necessary documentation and comply with all background check procedures.

What does GSA-compliant mean?

It means that a specific film and attachment system combination has been independently tested to meet or exceed the glass hazard performance requirements set by the General Services Administration for a given level of blast protection. We can provide the testing data and certification for the products we recommend.
